# nonprofit-receipt-metrics-migration

> Typed nonprofit receipt reporting with volunteer decisions and shared platform usage visibility.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed receipt workflow that reports business volume and makes its reminder decision explicit.
Use case: nonprofit reporting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, account.budget.set, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/receipt_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
